note: Judged 2026-10-21 over current tags, units and records. Quote verified in RFC 8665 Section 5: 'the E-, NP-, and M-Flags advertised by the next-hop router if that router advertised the SID for the prefix. This MUST be done regardless of whether the next-hop router contributes to the best path'. Product fix read: srInstaller.forwarding now applies the next hop's own advertisement (advertisedBy over Originator and Also), and sr_malformed resolve lists the other advertisers of the same SID. The positive has the best path end at 10.0.0.9 (NP set) with next hop 10.0.0.2 also advertising: NP clear must PHP-pop 18009 with no push, and NP+E must push 0, never 17009. The old originator-only code swapped 17009 and fails it. The negative checks that a next hop that advertised nothing gets 17009 with no pop, even though both other advertisers have NP clear.
